verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party import or migration feature, such as a CSV importer or a 'switch from tool X' importer. The closest items are App Directory listings for ongoing one-way or two-way sync integrations (e.g., with Jira, monday.com and Wrike) and generic ETL/automation connectors. These are adjacent sync features, apparently from third parties, not Asana's own onboarding import capability, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can import my data from another tool when switching over
